REPLACES the earlier verdict, which was correct when the hash had exactly one spelling and the exclusion list lived as a constant in two crates. Every new clause resolves: the recipe's parameters are data (`formats/hash_recipes/1.toml`, whose exclusion list is the same set the constant carried — proved by `recipes_share_the_digest_on_a_normal_tree`, which would fail if the sets differed); the ordering rule is a callable function rather than an inline `sort` (order_paths:105), which is what makes recipe 0's and recipe 1's difference statable instead of implicit; and recipe 0 is deliberately NOT a file — a temporary edit to the recipe file was shown to fail the frozen golden and then reverted, which is the whole reason the identity carries a recipe id at all.
